paragraphs: I build digital products that connect technology, design, and business — understanding problems before shipping solutions that people actually use.

highlights.title: How I work
items: I start by understanding the problem — business, users, and constraints — before jumping into code.
I build products end to end: web, mobile, backend and the design decisions in between.
I use AI as a working companion: to think faster, explore options, and ship better software.

about.title: Hi, I'm Eva.
intro: I'm a Product Engineer with more than six years of experience building digital products.

I started my career in web development, but curiosity has always pushed me beyond that. Today I enjoy working across the entire product lifecycle—from understanding requirements and designing user experiences to defining technical solutions and delivering them to production.
What motivates me isn't writing code for its own sake; it's building products that solve real problems and create value for users.
Outside of coding, I'm constantly exploring new technologies, especially AI-powered tools that help me work smarter and deliver better software.
experienceIntro: Over the last six years, I've had the opportunity to work on fintech products, educational and enterprise platforms, e-commerce, and cloud solutions.

My experience started in web development, evolved into technical leadership, and eventually expanded to product design, backend, automation, and software architecture. Today I'm building my own products as an independent engineer.
Each role has taught me something different, but they all share one thing in common: building products that people actually use.
about.experienceNote: A short tour of the path — the full story lives in the resume.

jobs.summary: Building products end-to-end with AI-assisted development: Coffee Master (AI barista chat powered by Claude, web and mobile, with streaming and per-user limits), Patio (a reasoning game for kids with a teacher panel) and ProveCheck (a field-service app).

Worked end-to-end, design to production, on wallet payment and checkout flows for users across four continents. Designed a multi-tenant architecture with Module Federation, built a multi-currency portal and a user-management panel from scratch, migrated apps from Create React App to Vite (~80% faster builds) and mentored a developer from junior to semi-senior.

jobs.company: IUGO Software & Design Studio by Domus Global · Montevideo, Uruguay
jobs.summary: Through staff augmentation at D24 and ERON International (payments), built merchant, admin and internal finance panels and led the redesign and rebrand of a creator payouts portal. Also built an admin panel and a user app with games, achievements and events for a kids' education platform.
Worked on web apps, e-commerce, corporate sites and cloud solutions with Azure, Power Platform, Vue/Nuxt and React.
Built landing pages and dashboards with Vue.js and D3.js, including a drag-and-drop UML diagram editor.
